description: This file contains the PHP class `Statistics` within the `Opencart\Catalog\Model\Report` namespace. It defines methods for retrieving and manipulating statistics data stored in a database, including getting statistics, getting a specific value, adding, removing, and editing values.

classes.name: Statistics
classes.description: A model class responsible for CRUD operations on statistics data within the OpenCart catalog reporting system.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves all statistics records from the database as an array.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a given statistic code.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Increments the value of a statistic identified by code.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Decrements the value of a statistic identified by code.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a statistic to a specific value.
